exercises.title: Levels and types 1 — Figure 1-1
exercises.problemHtml:
Figure 1-1 of Wiegers reads top-down: business requirements (why) → user requirements (what users must be able to do) → functional requirements (what the system must do), each stored in its own artefact; business rules, quality attributes, external interfaces and constraints feed in from the sides.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hình 1-1 của Wiegers đọc từ trên xuống: business requirements (vì sao) → user requirements (người dùng phải làm được gì) → functional requirements (hệ thống phải làm gì), mỗi loại lưu trong tài liệu riêng; business rules, quality attributes, external interfaces và constraints đi vào từ hai bên.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Levels and types 1 — Figure 1-1 — answer key

1. Which level answers WHY the organisation builds the system?Cấp nào trả lời VÌ SAO tổ chức xây hệ thống?
   Answer: b) Business requirements
   Business requirements state the business benefits sought.VI: Business requirement nêu lợi ích nghiệp vụ mong đạt.

2. Where are business requirements usually recorded?Business requirement thường được ghi ở đâu?
   Answer: b) In the vision and scope document
   The vision and scope document (Chapter 5).VI: Tài liệu tầm nhìn & phạm vi (Chương 5).

3. User requirements are typically represented as…User requirement thường được biểu diễn bằng…
   Answer: a) use cases, user stories or event-response tables
   They describe what users must be able to do.VI: Chúng mô tả người dùng phải làm được gì.

4. A business rule is…Một business rule là…
   Answer: b) a policy, regulation, standard or algorithm that exists outside any one application and often leads to functional requirements
   It is not itself a software requirement, but functional requirements trace back to it.VI: Tự nó không phải yêu cầu phần mềm, nhưng yêu cầu chức năng truy về nó.

5. In Wiegers’ book, "system requirements" means…Trong sách Wiegers, "system requirements" nghĩa là…
   Answer: b) requirements of a product made of several components — software, hardware, even people
   The book does NOT use the term for "detailed software requirements".VI: Sách KHÔNG dùng thuật ngữ này cho "yêu cầu phần mềm chi tiết".

exercises.title: Levels and types 2 — classify the requirements of an airline kiosk
exercises.problemHtml:
The textbook’s running example: an airline builds self-service check-in kiosks. Classify each statement with the types of Figure 1-1.

Requirements

exercises.problemHtmlVi:

# Levels and types 2 — classify the requirements of an airline kiosk — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Business requirement
   - r1.k: User requirement
   - r2.k: Functional requirement
   - r3.k: Business rule
   - r4.k: Quality attribute
   - r5.k: External interface
   - r6.k: Constraint
   - r7.k: Business rule
   - r8.k: External interface
   - r9.k: User requirement
   Why (business) → what users do (user) → what the kiosk does (functional); policies outside the software (business rule); how well (quality attribute); connections to devices and systems (external interface); limits on the design (constraint).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Why (business) → what users do (user) → what the kiosk does (functional); policies outside the software (business rule); how well (quality attribute); connections to devices and systems (external interface); limits on the design (constraint).

bang.de:
Choose the right value for every row.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

o.s: Reduce the cost of counter staff by 25% within two years. — Giảm 25% chi phí nhân viên quầy trong hai năm.
A passenger needs to check in for a flight and print a boarding pass. — Hành khách cần check-in và in thẻ lên máy bay.
The kiosk shall print a boarding pass for every flight segment the passenger has checked in for. — Kiosk in thẻ cho mọi chặng đã check-in.
Passengers may check in no earlier than 24 hours before departure. — Chỉ được check-in sớm nhất 24 giờ trước giờ bay.
A first-time passenger shall complete check-in in under 2 minutes in 90% of cases. — Hành khách lần đầu check-in xong dưới 2 phút trong 90% trường hợp.
The kiosk shall read passports through the reader’s USB HID interface. — Kiosk đọc hộ chiếu qua giao diện USB HID của đầu đọc.
The kiosk software must run on the vendor’s locked-down Linux image. — Phần mềm kiosk phải chạy trên bản Linux khoá của nhà cung cấp.
Seats in emergency exit rows may only be assigned to passengers aged 15 or older. — Ghế hàng thoát hiểm chỉ xếp cho khách từ 15 tuổi.
The kiosk shall send each check-in to the departure control system through its SOAP API. — Kiosk gửi mỗi lượt check-in tới hệ thống điều hành chuyến bay qua API SOAP.
A passenger wants to choose a seat while checking in. — Hành khách muốn chọn ghế khi check-in.

bang.giaiThich: Why (business) → what users do (user) → what the kiosk does (functional); policies outside the software (business rule); how well (quality attribute); connections to devices and systems (external interface); limits on the design (constraint).

mistakesJson.loi: Xếp luật 24 giờ là functional — đó là business rule; yêu cầu chức năng (từ chối check-in quá sớm) được rút ra từ nó.
Xếp giao diện đọc hộ chiếu là constraint — đó là external interface.

exercises.title: Levels and types 3 — from why to what
exercises.problemHtml:
Requirements at different levels must align: every functional requirement should trace up to a user requirement, which traces up to a business requirement. Put each chain in order, from the top level down.

# Levels and types 3 — from why to what — answer key

1. A kiosk chainChuỗi của kiosk
   Answer: a) Reduce counter staff cost by 25%  →  b) A passenger checks in for a flight  →  c) The kiosk shall print a boarding pass for each checked-in segment  →  d) Test: a two-segment trip prints two boarding passes
   Business → user → functional → the test that verifies it.VI: Business → user → functional → test kiểm chứng nó.

2. A library chainChuỗi của thư viện
   Answer: a) Halve the number of books returned late  →  b) A reader wants to know when each loan is due  →  c) The system shall e-mail a reminder 2 days before a loan is due  →  d) The reminder job runs every day at 07:00
   Objective → user need → functional requirement → design/implementation detail.VI: Mục tiêu → nhu cầu người dùng → yêu cầu chức năng → chi tiết thiết kế/hiện thực.

exercises.title: Levels and types 4 — trace each functional requirement to its user requirement
exercises.problemHtml:
The kiosk team wrote three user requirements and eight functional requirements. Every functional requirement must trace to exactly one user requirement; one of them traces to none — it is gold plating (nobody asked for it).

  • UR-1 A passenger checks in for a flight.
  • UR-2 A passenger chooses or changes a seat.
  • UR-3 A passenger checks a bag.
  • FR-1 The kiosk shall find a booking by booking reference or passport.
  • FR-2 The kiosk shall show the seat map of the flight.
  • FR-3 The kiosk shall print a bag tag for each checked bag.
  • FR-4 The kiosk shall print the boarding pass.
  • FR-5 The kiosk shall refuse a seat in an exit row to a passenger younger than 15.
  • FR-6 The kiosk shall weigh each bag and show the excess-baggage fee.
  • FR-7 The kiosk shall play a welcome video with the airline’s latest promotions.
  • FR-8 The kiosk shall refuse check-in earlier than 24 hours before departure.

Write TRACE: for each FR the user requirement it comes from, or "NONE".

Requirements

  • One entry per functional requirement, value "UR-1", "UR-2", "UR-3" or "NONE".
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Đội kiosk viết ba yêu cầu người dùng và tám yêu cầu chức năng. Mỗi yêu cầu chức năng phải truy về đúng một yêu cầu người dùng; có một cái không truy về đâu — đó là gold plating (không ai yêu cầu). Viết TRACE: với mỗi FR ghi UR nguồn, hoặc "NONE".

Yêu cầu

  • Mỗi FR một mục, giá trị "UR-1", "UR-2", "UR-3" hoặc "NONE".

examplesJson.input: FR-4 The kiosk shall print the boarding pass.
examplesJson.explanation: Printing the boarding pass is part of checking in.|||In thẻ lên máy bay là một phần của check-in.

hintsJson: Đọc từng FR và hỏi: nó giúp hành khách làm việc nào (check-in, chọn ghế, gửi hành lý)?
Luật (24 giờ, 15 tuổi) được thực thi bên trong use case mà nó chặn.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: FR-1, FR-4, FR-8 → UR-1; FR-2, FR-5 → UR-2; FR-3, FR-6 → UR-3; FR-7 → NONE (gold plating). Tracing upward is how you find requirements nobody asked for.
